title: The Lost Texan Apartment - Near Gaylord Opryland
description:
The Lost Texan Apartment is a completely private apartment, with a Texas theme. Very quiet neighborhood, close to Opryland Hotel and Resort. Huge shower, NEW king size bed, granite counter-tops, polished concrete floors, fridge, microwave, and living room.

The space
The Lost Texan Apartment was just completed and is ready for your enjoyment. New KING sized bed, fold-out Queen sized couch, fridge and freezer, microwave, Keurig coffee machine, huge bathroom with granite countertops. It has a private entrance and parking space.  Please no smoking or vaping in or around the property.

Other things to note
We have had many great guests, but several not so great guests insisted on smoking in or around the property even after reading the no smoking request. An additional $75 fee will be charged if smoke smell is detected after the visit.
